texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的信号的初期解读工作使[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]陷入困惑。它们似乎主要是白噪音，没有任何可以被识别为语言的东西。有一段时间，人们甚至怀疑我们是否在处理一个智慧物种的语言，尽管有可见的证据表明他们确实使用了某种技术。

只有当我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]试着调整我们的仪器以检测超出我们[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]正常听力范围的声音时，才检测到某种像是语言的东西。不幸的是，这对我们解读工作提出了相当大的挑战，因为在不借助仪器的情况下，我们根本听不见它们……
texts.en:
Initial readings of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] signals left [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] bewildered. They seemed to be mainly white noise, devoid of anything which could be recognized as language. For a time, there were even doubts as to whether we were dealing with the utterings of an intelligent species, despite the visual evidence of their use of technology.

It was only when our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] experimented with tuning our instruments to detect sounds well outside the normal range frequencies of our [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural] that patterns indicative of a language were detected. Unfortunately, this poses considerable challenges for our quest to come to understand them, since we will not be able to hear them at all without assistance...
